recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨核細胞數量增加，多數為中至大型、細胞核呈圓形不分葉或僅輕微分葉（hypolobated/monolobated），在細胞質豐富的背景下特別醒目，這是 del(5q) 骨髓增生不良症候群的典型巨核細胞型態。
features: Increased megakaryocytes, medium to large, scattered singly and loosely
Megakaryocyte nuclei round, monolobated or hypolobated, eccentric or central
Abundant eosinophilic megakaryocytic cytoplasm with preserved size (not micromegakaryocytes)
Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis including erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes
No obvious sheets of blasts or megakaryocyte clusters with bizarre hyperlobation
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are increased and are predominantly normal-sized to large with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. Erythroid and granulocytic maturation is present, and no sheets of blasts are identified in this field. In the appropriate cytogenetic context, the megakaryocyte morphology is characteristic of myelodysplastic syndrome with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated, staghorn nuclei rather than round monolobated nuclei, and del(5q) is absent.
These typically show micromegakaryocytes or separated nuclear lobes rather than uniform large hypolobated forms; karyotype separates them.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T has ET/PMF-like hyperlobated megakaryocytes and ring sideroblasts, with SF3B1 mutation rather than isolated del(5q).
